subject: Request to substitute a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the

messages.text: We would like to substitute a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the specified packaged rooftop AHU, per Section 23 05 00. This is becoming a priority given current lead times. No cost adjustment is anticipated for this substitution. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. Please respond within five business days so we can place the order. Note: the unrelated HVAC filter-replacement invoice from last month does not apply to this substitution.

Substitution of a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the specified packaged rooftop AHU is approved provided performance data confirms equivalence to Section 23 05 00. No cost adjustment is anticipated for this substitution.
